verified.name: Engine Ventures
verified.thesis: Engine Ventures invests in early-stage Tough Tech companies solving the world's most important challenges through breakthrough science and engineering. The firm focuses on transformational technology that solves the world's most important challenges through the convergence of breakthrough science, engineering and entrepreneurship.
verified.notes: Engine Ventures spun out as a separate investment firm from The Engine in 2023. The Engine itself is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit incubator and accelerator. Per Wikipedia: 'In 2023, the investment fund separated from The Engine and rebranded as the venture capital firm Engine Ventures.' No current senior partners explicitly named on firm's website or Wikipedia. AUM and flagship fund name not found in sources.

changes.current: Engine Ventures invests in early-stage Tough Tech companies solving the world's most important challenges through breakthrough science and engineering. The firm focuses on hardware-based technologies across deep tech fields including biotech, robotics, green energy, agriculture, manufacturing, material science, and quantum computing.
